lead: Dele Alli has built a public profile as a British association football player, born on 11 April 1996 in Milton Keynes.
As of 2026, he is 30 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.
He has represented Milton Keynes Dons F.C. and Tottenham Hotspur F.C.
The sections that follow break down Dele Alli's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Dele Alli — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Dele Alli was born on 11 April 1996 in Milton Keynes, and holds British nationality. He was given the name Bamidele Jermaine Alli at birth and is publicly known as Dele Alli.
He studied at The Radcliffe School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Dele Alli — Career and Professional Work
paras: Dele Alli works primarily as an association football player.

On the team sheet, Dele has been associated with Milton Keynes Dons F.C. (from 2011 to 2015), Tottenham Hotspur F.C. (from 2015 to 2022), Milton Keynes Dons F.C. (from 2015 to 2015), Everton F.C. (from 2022 to 2024), England national under-17 association football team (from 2012 to 2013), England national under-18 association football team (from 2014 to 2014), England national under-19 association football team (from 2014 to 2015) and England national under-21 association football team (from 2015 to 2015). He plays as a midfielder.
He has taken part in UEFA Euro 2016 and 2018 FIFA World Cup.
